Today in AI NOW & BEYOND 🔥 When Agents Go Off-Script: Catching and Fixing Policy Violations in Salesforce Google just cracked a 20-year quantum computing problem AI Resources On Our Radar When Agents Go Off-Script: Catching and Fixing Policy Violations in Salesforce AI agents work directly inside CRMs—reading data and updating records without human review. But what happens when an agent follows instructions and still violates policy? Join our technical deep dive: Detect, Stop, and Remediate with Rubrik Agent Cloud. See a real-world scenario where a Salesforce agent goes off-script, learn how to govern agent activity, and get a repeatable framework for production deployments. Bonus: Receive a $15 Amazon gift card for attending. Reserve Your Spot Google just cracked a 20-year quantum computing problem Google says its Willow chip has overcome a major obstacle in quantum computing. The results look promising, but we’re still a long way from having practical quantum computers. Google reduced errors by 40 times using a technique called magic state cultivation, which helps make complex quantum calculations more reliable. The team achieved 99.99% logical fidelity, meaning the special quantum states needed for calculations were produced with extremely low error rates. The breakthrough was published in Science, but Google still needs to prove the technique works on much larger quantum systems. Why it matters: Quantum computers waste enormous resources correcting errors. Google’s approach could make powerful machines easier to build, but scaling it up remains the real test. Musk's SpaceX–Tesla merger talk, Solana's Alpenglow launch and a White House scam crackdown set the tone, while Drift's hacker resurfaces. 🚀 SpaceX and Tesla Explore Merger That Would Unite 30,221 BTC Elon Musk said on SpaceX's Q3 earnings call that independent-director committees at both companies are weighing a tie-up. A deal would fold SpaceX's 18,712 BTC and Tesla's 11,509 BTC into one corporate treasury, though no terms have been agreed and Musk stressed it is not guaranteed.
